dense.label: Dense (production)
dense.description: Cosine similarity over text-embedding-3-small vectors — the query shipped in lib/vector/search.ts.

lexical.label: Lexical (Postgres FTS)
lexical.description: ts_rank_cd over a generated tsvector indexing raw content, camel/snake-split content, and the file path.

bm25.label: BM25 (in-process)
bm25.description: Textbook BM25 (k1=1.2, b=0.75) over the same code-aware tokens — a reference point for the Postgres FTS ranking.

hybrid_equal.label: Hybrid (dense + lexical, equal RRF)
hybrid_equal.description: Unweighted reciprocal rank fusion — every arm gets the same vote.

hybrid.label: Hybrid (dense + lexical, RRF)
hybrid.description: Dense and lexical candidates fused by reciprocal rank (k=60), 30 per arm. This is lib/vector/hybrid.ts measured directly.

hybrid_bm25.label: Hybrid (dense + BM25, RRF)
hybrid_bm25.description: The same fusion with BM25 as the lexical arm — an upper bound on what a better lexical ranker would buy.

dense_prior.label: Dense + source prior
dense_prior.description: Dense top-40 re-ordered by similarity x a weight for implementation vs test/docs/example/config, then cut to k.

hybrid_prior.label: Hybrid + source prior
hybrid_prior.description: Weighted dense+lexical fusion, then the same source-kind re-ordering.
